image_description: A Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) positioned centrally on a bed of smooth, rounded river stones. The crab displays a broad, oval carapace with mottled brownish-grey coloration. Its first pair of legs are modified into large claws (chelipeds), and multiple walking legs extend laterally. The ventral side is partially visible, showing lighter cream/white tones.
